# Ekonomens AI-varning: ”Kraschar till slut – som det brukar”

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-10-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Macro veteran Rose-Marie Westman and Kjetil Houg, CIO of Folketrygdfondet (Norway's NOK 450bn Nordic-focused state fund), discussed rising rates pressing on equities, whether a 60/40 portfolio could make a comeback, and the risk of an AI investment bubble. Westman expects the AI capex boom, now 3.8% of US GDP, to eventually crash rather than land softly. She pointed to widening CDS spreads on AI firms, circular financing and pressure from cheap Chinese open-weight models. Houg was more measured because hyperscalers are profitable, and he called Nordic and Swedish small caps an attractive buying opportunity given low AI exposure and stable quality.
